findings.description: The cycle guard was removed from the walk over the __cause__ chain, so a cyclic chain now makes the while loop run forever.
findings.rationale: If an exception's __cause__ chain loops back on itself (for example e.__cause__ = e, or e1.__cause__ = e2 and e2.__cause__ = e1, which Python permits when set manually), the loop at line 180 never reaches None and never exits. Under that input the retry predicate hangs the calling thread instead of returning a result, so the program appears stuck.
